create_byt5_tokenizer: create a ByT5 tokenizer instance with custom extra_ids and special tokens for byte-level text tokenization
build_token_ids_with_special_tokens: build model input IDs by concatenating sequences and adding end-of-sequence special tokens
get_special_tokens_mask: get a special tokens mask list for token IDs indicating which positions are special tokens
convert_bytes_to_tokens: convert a text string into byte-level tokens using UTF-8 encoding and character mapping
convert_tokens_to_string: convert a sequence of byte-level tokens back into a decoded UTF-8 string
